subject: Re: Payment ladder proposal + VAT entity routing for Aventis pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aventishealth.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing cadence and VAT routing

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Aventis has one remaining question for the pilot SOW: we typically run Net60 for new vendors during POCs, and given the EU entity setup we need clear VAT routing (which legal must see).

Specifically: would Redwood accept a staged invoice ladder (30/30/40) on Net60 overall, with the first invoice due 30 days after invoice date, and the remainder following the milestone acceptance dates? We also need the invoice to be issued by Redwood EU (VAT ID attached) so our tax team can reclaim.

If possible, can you confirm a provisional credit ceiling for the pilot (we expect monthly consumption to peak around $35k) and any documentation you need to approve the Net60 for a pilot?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement — Aventis Health
accounts@aventishealth.com

Attachment: Aventis_VAT_certificate.pdf

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aventishealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence and VAT routing

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the VAT cert. Quick notes:

- We can issue invoices from Redwood EU (please confirm the exact legal name and billing address you expect on the invoice).
- Staged ladder is OK in principle; we typically do 50/25/25 for pilots, but I can put together a 30/30/40 schedule if that aligns better with your milestone acceptance cadence.
- For Net60 on a pilot, finance requires: corporate credit references (1-2), a PO or signed SOW, and an agreed provisional credit limit. We can expedite review once we have those.

Proposed counter: Accept Net60 with the staged ladder 30/30/40, but Redwood will require a provisional credit ceiling of $50k for the pilot period and a 20% refundable hold (applied as an escrow line) on the final tranche if we see consumption spike beyond projections.

If that sounds reasonable I will loop in Naomi from billing to prepare the invoice schedule and Marissa from finance to start the credit check.

Next steps I propose:
- Liam: confirm billing legal name + PO number
- Aventis: provide corporate reference contact (can be one reference)
- Camila: share draft invoice ladder and DocuSign for SOW addendum

Happy to schedule 20 minutes today if you want to run through.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aventishealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence and VAT routing

Hi all — looping in finance approvals. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Credit ceiling: we can provisionally approve $50,000 for the pilot (as Camila suggested) pending receipt of the PO and a single corporate credit reference.
2) Hold / escrow: the 20% refundable hold on the final tranche is acceptable for a first-month provisioning. We will reduce the hold to 10% upon receipt of on-time payment of the first two invoices.
3) Invoice timing & Net60: We will mark invoices Net60 but our standard remittance terms for staged invoices are based on invoice date. For the ladder to work operationally, Aventis should confirm milestone acceptance windows so that our ops team can tie invoice dates to milestone sign-offs.

Action items for Aventis (Liam):
- Provide PO and billing legal name/address for Redwood EU invoices
- Provide one corporate credit reference contact (name, role, phone/email)
- Confirm milestone acceptance cadence (approx dates or SLA language)

Attachments: I will prepare a DocuSign addendum (SOW payment ladder) and a provisional credit request form — Camila / Naomi will send.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
